authorization_scope: EVIDENCE_ONLY; v1 enforced; v2 PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; prospective BLOCKED; historical STILL_BLOCKED; no warehouse/model/forecast/evaluation/activation
capture_boundary: Actual Scrapy downloader callback priority 200; accepted CaptureStoreV2 API and immutable resolver unchanged. Robots .txt URL cannot enter accepted URL schema: preserve exact supporting bytes and independent ledger with null accepted receipt. Receipt preparation is not source freshness or wire-send time.
follow_rules: Before every first content request per exact scheme/host origin, read that origin plus /robots.txt. Supporting reads count. Missing/error/denied/unparseable robots fails closed.

Initial request order is fixed. Robots gate precedes the first request per origin. No unrelated links, occurrence-detail expansion, assets, browser subrequests or pagination are scheduled. Preserve entire profile response including every observed DWCS/Road to UFC row; expose any unsatisfied pagination limitation.

Only 301/302/303/307/308 with an explicit public Location to the same exact path and query, approved hosts, no HTTPS downgrade and no loop may be followed; at most three redirects per chain. Every hop has its own attempt/bytes/ledger. Robots redirects carry their exact chain and apply final policy to the origins in that chain. Content redirects to a new origin must pass its independent robots gate.
Never merge HTTP/HTTPS identities. www removal for UUID5 is a disclosed computational binding only.

No implicit robots middleware requests. ROBOTSTXT_OBEY=false disables that middleware only; the explicit counted gate enforces restrictions, including stopping rather than exceeding this fixed pace for stricter crawl delay/rate.

Preserve Date/Age/Cache-Control/Content-Encoding only. Do not copy cookies, authorization, browser sessions, proxies, project settings, environment header values or browser UA. BrowserLikeContextFactory performs normal TLS certificate/hostname verification only.
stop_conditions: network failure or essential-page HTTP error including robots
robots denial, unknown policy or stricter-than-fixed pace
cache-marked response or nonzero/invalid upstream Age
credentials, bypass or additional authority would be needed
publication/internal/interruption failure; never retry or resume

url_provenance.listing_rule: exact indexed listing URLs; completed?page=all; upcoming
